lieu: front door of a house in Riviera, Cocody, Abidjan, at 2 a.m., porch light on, moths around the lamp, a wall clock showing 2 o'clock visible through the window

persos.nom: the wife with the rolling pin
persos.desc: furious wife in her 40s, lime-green wax nightgown, hair in pink rollers, holding a wooden rolling pin
persos.pose: standing in the doorway, hands on hips, blocking the entrance

persos.nom: the husband with the loose tie
persos.desc: sneaky husband in his 40s, navy suit jacket over an untucked shirt, loosened red tie, holding his shoes in his hand
persos.pose: frozen mid-tiptoe on the doorstep, guilty smile

dialogue: Tu étais où jusqu'à deux heures, hein ?!
Réunion des maris fidèles, chérie.
Jusqu'à deux heures ?
On était deux. On attendait les autres dêh.
jeu: The wife taps the rolling pin in her palm. The husband answers with a proud straight face, then shrugs innocently.
chute: The wife slowly raises one eyebrow and the rolling pin; the husband smiles nervously. End on a close-up of the husband's sweating face looking into the camera.

lieu: public secondary school classroom in Attecoube, Abidjan, wooden benches, chalkboard, morning sun through louvered windows

persos.nom: the teacher with the bow tie
persos.desc: strict male teacher in his 50s, brown bow tie, short-sleeve mustard shirt, thin mustache, holding a ruler
persos.pose: holding out his hand for the homework

persos.nom: the sleepy schoolboy
persos.desc: sleepy schoolboy around 13, khaki uniform, puffy eyes, pillow mark on his cheek, cornrows
persos.pose: standing at his desk, yawning

dialogue: Mon petit, où est ton devoir ?
Maître, hier y avait délestage dêh.
Et ce matin ?
Ce matin, y avait sommeil.
jeu: The teacher holds out his hand. The boy answers sadly, then with a huge yawn.
chute: The boy falls asleep standing up and starts snoring. End on a close-up of the teacher's exasperated face staring into the camera.

lieu: garba stall at lunchtime in Adjame, Abidjan, big aluminium bowl of attieke, pile of fried tuna pieces, wooden bench, plastic plates, workers queuing

persos.nom: the hungry mason
persos.desc: hungry mason in his 30s, cement-dusted grey overalls, yellow hard hat, holding out a plastic plate of attieke
persos.pose: holding out his plate with both hands, begging

persos.nom: the garba seller with the tongs
persos.desc: garba seller in her 50s, red-and-white checkered headscarf, big gold earrings, apron, holding a tiny piece of tuna with tongs
persos.pose: placing a tiny piece of tuna on the plate with a sweet smile

dialogue: Tantie, mets beaucoup thon dêh, j'ai faim !
Voilà. Thon est timide aujourd'hui.
jeu: The mason begs. The seller drops one tiny piece of tuna on the huge pile of attieke and answers sweetly.
chute: The mason searches through the pile of attieke with his finger to find the tuna. End on a close-up of the mason's desperate face looking into the camera.

lieu: blue metal front gate of a small house in Koumassi, Abidjan, potted plants, afternoon

persos.nom: the creditor with the notebook
persos.desc: stern creditor in her 50s, royal-purple boubou with a matching tall headwrap, thick notebook of debts under her arm
persos.pose: standing at the gate, suspicious

persos.nom: the little girl at the gate
persos.desc: little girl around 6, two high puffs with yellow ribbons, polka-dot dress
persos.pose: holding the gate, answering innocently

dialogue: Ma fille, ta maman-là est là ?
Elle dit elle n'est pas là.
Et ton papa ?
Lui, il est caché sous lit dêh.
jeu: The creditor asks. The little girl answers innocently and points inside the house.
chute: The creditor opens her notebook and starts writing angrily. End on a close-up of the little girl's proud innocent smile looking into the camera.

lieu: inside an overcrowded green-and-yellow gbaka minibus in Yopougon traffic, passengers squeezed on benches, open sliding door

persos.nom: the apprentice hanging at the door
persos.desc: wiry bus apprentice in his 20s, backwards orange cap, sleeveless black jersey, coins in hand
persos.pose: hanging from the open door, waving more passengers in

persos.nom: the big man in the brown suit
persos.desc: very large man in his 40s, sweaty face, tight chocolate-brown suit, briefcase on his lap
persos.pose: crushed between passengers, outraged

persos.nom: the old lady with the hen
persos.desc: tiny old lady in her 70s, sky-blue headwrap, holding a live hen on her lap
persos.pose: squeezed against the window, rolling her eyes

dialogue: Serrez-vous, serrez-vous ! Y a encore place !
Où ça ? Sur mes genoux ?!
Tonton, tes genoux sont libres, non ?
jeu: The apprentice shouts and points inside. The big man protests, then the apprentice points innocently at his knees.
chute: The apprentice drops a big sack of yams onto the big man's knees. End on a close-up of the big man's outraged face looking into the camera.

lieu: night in a neighborhood of Port-Bouet, Abidjan, power cut everywhere, only one house lit up thanks to a noisy smoking generator in its yard

persos.nom: the annoyed neighbor in the nightgown
persos.desc: annoyed neighbor in her 40s, long sky-blue nightgown, hair wrapped in a black scarf
persos.pose: leaning over the fence, covering her ears

persos.nom: the proud generator owner
persos.desc: proud man in his 50s, shiny silver tracksuit, gold sunglasses at night, sitting on a plastic chair next to the generator
persos.pose: sitting proudly, patting the generator

dialogue: Vieux père, ton groupe fait trop bruit dêh !
Ma sœur, c'est bruit de la richesse.
Hum… Richesse-là vient de partir.
jeu: The neighbor complains. The man pats his generator proudly. Suddenly the generator coughs and dies, and his house goes completely dark. Then the neighbor answers.
chute: In the darkness only the man's gold sunglasses shine. End on a close-up of the neighbor's mocking face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Angre, Cocody, Abidjan, old armchairs with crochet covers, family photos, afternoon light

persos.nom: the grandson with the toy dinosaur
persos.desc: grandson around 7, green dinosaur pajamas, holding a toy T-rex
persos.pose: showing the toy dinosaur excitedly

persos.nom: the grandmother with the big glasses
persos.desc: tiny grandmother in her 80s, huge round glasses, lavender wax dress, white hair in small braids
persos.pose: knitting in her armchair, answering proudly

persos.nom: the grandfather with the black fez
persos.desc: grandfather in his 80s, white goatee, black fez hat, olive-green kaftan, walking cane
persos.pose: walking past behind them with his cane

dialogue: Mamie, tu as vu les dinosaures ?
Oui. C'est ton grand-père qui les nourrissait.
Et c'est toi qui les as mangés dêh !
jeu: The boy asks. The grandmother answers proudly. The grandfather stops behind her and fires back.
chute: The grandmother slowly lowers her knitting and glares at the grandfather, who hurries away. End on a close-up of the grandson laughing into the camera.

lieu: job interview office in a glass tower of the Plateau district, Abidjan, desk with a laptop, city view

persos.nom: the recruiter with the red glasses
persos.desc: sharp recruiter in her 30s, black blazer, red cat-eye glasses, sleek bun, CV in hand
persos.pose: reading the CV, skeptical

persos.nom: the candidate with the sleeping mat
persos.desc: candidate in his 20s, oversized purple suit, big backpack with a rolled sleeping mat strapped on it
persos.pose: sitting straight with a determined smile

dialogue: Pourquoi on doit vous prendre, mon gars ?
Mon papa a dit : sans travail, faut pas rentrer.
Et alors ?
Donc je dors chez vous ce soir dêh.
jeu: The recruiter asks. The candidate answers seriously, then unrolls his sleeping mat on the office floor.
chute: The candidate lies down on his mat in the office with a little pillow. End on a close-up of the recruiter's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of an apartment in Marcory, Abidjan, evening, leather sofa, TV showing a football match, low table with drinks

persos.nom: the wife with her palm out
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, coral-red wrap dress, long box braids, pearl earrings
persos.pose: standing over the sofa, palm out, suspicious

persos.nom: the husband hiding his phone
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, green Ivory Coast away football jersey, short twists
persos.pose: sinking into the sofa, hiding his phone behind his back

dialogue: Chéri, donne-moi ton téléphone-là.
Il est en mode avion, bébé.
Ya fohi. Qu'il atterrisse dans ma main !
jeu: The wife holds out her hand. The husband hesitates. She snaps her fingers and points at her palm.
chute: The husband slowly flies the phone like a little airplane into her palm with a forced smile. End on a close-up of the wife's victorious smirk into the camera.

lieu: supermarket aisle in Treichville, Abidjan, shelves of rice bags and oil bottles, a security camera on the ceiling

persos.nom: the nostalgic grandmother
persos.desc: grandmother in her 70s, burgundy wax dress with matching headwrap, small purse, wooden walking stick
persos.pose: telling her story nostalgically

persos.nom: the grandson with the cart
persos.desc: grandson in his 20s, black t-shirt, gold chain, dreadlocks, pushing a shopping cart
persos.pose: pointing discreetly at the security camera

dialogue: Dans mon temps, avec cent francs, je ramenais riz, huile et poisson dêh !
Mamie, maintenant y a caméras partout.
jeu: The grandmother remembers proudly. The grandson points discreetly at the security camera.
chute: The grandmother quickly pulls a small bag of rice out of her purse and puts it back on the shelf, whistling innocently. End on a close-up of the grandmother's innocent face looking into the camera.

lieu: shared rental courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, row of colorful doors, water tank, plastic buckets, late afternoon

persos.nom: the landlord in the white three-piece suit
persos.desc: plump landlord in his 60s, white three-piece suit, panama hat, receipt book in hand
persos.pose: announcing proudly, finger raised

persos.nom: the tenant on the bucket
persos.desc: relaxed tenant in his 30s, orange singlet, towel around his neck, flip-flops
persos.pose: sitting on an upside-down bucket, brushing his teeth

dialogue: À partir de ce mois, je double loyer !
Ya fohi, Tonton. Même premier-là, je payais pas.
jeu: The landlord announces proudly. The tenant answers calmly with toothpaste foam around his mouth.
chute: The other tenants peek out of their doors and nod in agreement. End on a close-up of the landlord's speechless face looking into the camera.

lieu: crowded football stadium stands in Abidjan under a bright sun, fans in orange, white and green with flags and horns

persos.nom: the employee with the face paint
persos.desc: man in his 30s, face painted orange-white-green, orange afro wig, football scarf, phone on his ear
persos.pose: pretending to cough weakly into the phone

persos.nom: the cheering fan with the drum
persos.desc: big cheering fan in his 20s, white jersey, playing a large djembe drum
persos.pose: drumming wildly next to him

dialogue: Allô patron… Je suis vraiment malade dêh… Je peux pas venir…
BUUUUT !
jeu: The man coughs weakly into the phone, then the crowd erupts and he jumps up screaming goal with the phone still on his ear.
chute: He freezes, realizes, and slowly brings the phone back to his ear with a weak little cough. End on a close-up of his guilty face looking into the camera.

lieu: dining room in Bingerville near Abidjan, wooden table with a pot of very black sauce and a plate of rice, evening

persos.nom: the husband with the spoon
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, mint-green shirt, rimless glasses, holding up a spoon of black sauce
persos.pose: inspecting the black sauce suspiciously

persos.nom: the proud wife in the apron
persos.desc: proud wife in her 30s, flower-print apron over a yellow dress, short afro puff
persos.pose: hands on hips, proud smile

dialogue: Chérie, c'est quoi sauce noire-là ?
C'est recette de ta maman !
Ahh… C'est pour ça j'ai quitté la maison.
jeu: The husband inspects the sauce. The wife answers proudly. The husband slowly puts the spoon down.
chute: The husband pushes the plate away and pulls a packet of biscuits from his pocket. End on a close-up of the wife's furious face looking into the camera.

lieu: backyard of a house in Yopougon, Abidjan, a stool under a mango tree, laundry line, afternoon

persos.nom: the boy under the pot
persos.desc: boy around 8, bushy hair, striped blue t-shirt, sitting on a stool with an upside-down aluminium cooking pot on his head
persos.pose: sitting with the pot on his head, worried

persos.nom: the father with the big scissors
persos.desc: father in his 40s, faded green work shirt, big tailor scissors
persos.pose: cutting hair around the pot with big scissors, confident

dialogue: Papa, coiffeur c'est mille francs seulement dêh !
Assieds-toi. Papa a marmite et ciseaux.
jeu: The boy protests with the pot on his head. The father cuts around the pot with big scissors, confident.
chute: The father lifts the pot: the boy now has a perfectly round bowl haircut. End on a close-up of the boy's devastated face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Deux-Plateaux, Abidjan, armchair, framed diplomas on the wall, afternoon

persos.nom: the daughter in love
persos.desc: daughter in her 20s, lilac blouse, long straight wig, hands clasped
persos.pose: announcing shyly

persos.nom: the strict father with the newspaper
persos.desc: strict father in his 50s, dark-brown boubou with gold embroidery, reading glasses, newspaper
persos.pose: lowering his newspaper slowly

dialogue: Papa, mon copain veut venir se présenter.
Qu'il apporte CV et sac de riz.
Il est étudiant, papa !
Alors riz seulement suffit dêh.
jeu: The daughter announces shyly. The father lowers his newspaper slowly, lists his conditions, then simplifies them.
chute: The father calmly goes back to his newspaper. End on a close-up of the daughter's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: front door of a small house in Abobo, Abidjan, electricity meter on the wall, a single tiny bulb hanging inside

persos.nom: the electricity agent with the long bill
persos.desc: electricity agent in his 30s, high-visibility orange vest, blue cap, unrolling a very long bill
persos.pose: unrolling a very long bill that reaches the ground

persos.nom: the man with the tiny bulb
persos.desc: man in his 40s, faded wax shirt with a blue fish pattern, holding a tiny light bulb
persos.pose: staring at the bill, shocked

dialogue: Tonton, votre facture : quatre-vingt-cinq mille.
Vous allumez soleil chez moi ou bien ?
jeu: The agent unrolls the very long bill. The man holds up his only tiny bulb and protests.
chute: The man holds his tiny bulb next to the giant bill. End on a close-up of the agent trying hard not to laugh, looking into the camera.

lieu: inside a gbaka minibus in Adjame, Abidjan, the apprentice collecting fares, passengers on benches

persos.nom: the cheeky grandmother
persos.desc: cheeky grandmother in her 70s, emerald-green headwrap, big round sunglasses, small coin purse
persos.pose: handing over only half the coins with a proud smile

persos.nom: the apprentice with the red bandana
persos.desc: bus apprentice in his 20s, red bandana, sleeveless white tank top, coins in his palm
persos.pose: counting the coins in his palm

dialogue: Mon fils, je suis vieille dêh. Je paie moitié prix.
Ya fohi, Mamie. On te dépose à moitié chemin.
jeu: The grandmother hands over half the fare proudly. The apprentice counts the coins and answers with a smirk.
chute: The apprentice bangs on the side of the bus and it stops in the middle of nowhere. End on a close-up of the grandmother's outraged face looking into the camera.

lieu: busy roadside chicken grill in Yopougon at night, smoke, braised chickens on a barbecue grill, string of bulbs

persos.nom: the girlfriend in the silver dress
persos.desc: girlfriend in her 20s, sparkling silver mini dress, high ponytail, clutch bag
persos.pose: pointing at her boyfriend at the grill, shocked

persos.nom: the boyfriend at the grill
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, sweaty, sauce-stained apron over a sky-blue t-shirt, fanning the grill with cardboard
persos.pose: fanning the grill, caught red-handed

dialogue: Tu m'as dit que tu es médecin, hein ?!
Oui bébé. Je soigne poulets braisés.
jeu: The girlfriend discovers him and shouts. He answers proudly, turning a chicken like a patient.
chute: He proudly presents a braised chicken to her on a plate. End on a close-up of the girlfriend's disgusted face looking into the camera.

lieu: courtyard of a family house in Abobo, Abidjan, morning, a hammock between two posts, school bag on a plastic chair

persos.nom: the schoolgirl with her hand out
persos.desc: schoolgirl around 10, blue-and-white school uniform, two cornrow braids, backpack
persos.pose: holding out her hand to her father

persos.nom: the jobless father in the hammock
persos.desc: jobless father in his 40s, grey sweatpants, yellow t-shirt with holes, radio on his belly
persos.pose: lying in the hammock, relaxed

dialogue: Papa, donne-moi cinq cents pour la récré dêh !
Ma fille, moi-même je suis en récré depuis 2019.
jeu: The girl holds out her hand. The father answers without moving from the hammock.
chute: The father turns up the radio and swings gently in the hammock. End on a close-up of the girl's deadpan face looking into the camera.

lieu: evening in Koumassi, Abidjan, a man watching TV in his living room, his neighbor leaning in through the open window from outside

persos.nom: the TV owner with the remote
persos.desc: man in his 40s, saffron-yellow kaftan, short grey beard, remote control in hand
persos.pose: turning toward the window, annoyed

persos.nom: the neighbor at the window
persos.desc: neighbor in his 30s, black-and-white striped polo, eating peanuts from a paper cone
persos.pose: leaning comfortably on the windowsill

dialogue: Ça fait trois ans tu regardes ma télé !
Change chaîne, Vieux père. Film-là je connais déjà.
jeu: The owner shouts at the window. The neighbor keeps eating peanuts and complains about the program.
chute: The neighbor reaches inside, takes the remote from his hand and changes the channel himself. End on a close-up of the owner's speechless face looking into the camera.

lieu: doctor's office in a neighborhood clinic in Treichville, Abidjan, white walls, health posters, wooden desk

persos.nom: the doctor with burgundy twists
persos.desc: serious female doctor in her 40s, white coat, short twists dyed burgundy, stethoscope
persos.pose: writing a prescription, wagging her finger

persos.nom: the very thin patient
persos.desc: very thin man in his 50s, threadbare brown cardigan, patched trousers, hollow cheeks
persos.pose: sitting across the desk, shocked

dialogue: Tonton, faut arrêter la viande.
Docteur, c'est viande-là qui m'a arrêté depuis longtemps !
jeu: The doctor gives her advice very seriously. The thin man raises both hands in despair as he answers.
chute: The doctor looks him up and down, then slowly tears up her prescription. End on a close-up of the patient's sad face looking into the camera.

lieu: bedroom in Cocody, Abidjan, open wardrobe, a small travel bag on the bed

persos.nom: the wife on the phone
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, magenta wax dress, tall gele headwrap, phone in hand
persos.pose: announcing happily, phone in hand

persos.nom: the husband packing a bag
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, teal polo shirt, folding a shirt into a small bag
persos.pose: packing quickly

dialogue: Chéri, ma maman vient habiter avec nous dêh !
Ya fohi. Moi aussi je pars habiter chez elle.
jeu: The wife announces happily. The husband keeps packing calmly as he answers.
chute: The husband zips his bag, puts on his cap and walks out of the room whistling. End on a close-up of the wife's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: inside an old shared woro-woro taxi on a sunny Abidjan boulevard, dashboard with stickers, rear door rattling open

persos.nom: the passenger holding the door
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, mustard office suit, long straight wig, handbag
persos.pose: clinging to the rattling car door, terrified

persos.nom: the driver with the bushy mustache
persos.desc: cheerful taxi driver in his 50s, bald head, bushy grey mustache, chewing stick in his mouth
persos.pose: driving with one hand, relaxed

dialogue: Chauffeur, ta portière-là ne ferme pas !
Tiens ça bien, ma fille. C'est climatisation.
jeu: The passenger struggles with the door in the wind. The driver answers proudly, enjoying the breeze.
chute: The wind blows her wig out of the window. End on a close-up of the passenger's horrified face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Marcory, Abidjan, lunchtime, a guest seated on the sofa, a kitchen doorway visible

persos.nom: the guest in the safari suit
persos.desc: polite guest in his 50s, khaki safari suit, round belly, holding a glass of bissap juice
persos.pose: smiling politely, leaning toward the child

persos.nom: the honest little boy
persos.desc: honest little boy around 6, green bucket hat, white t-shirt, very serious face
persos.pose: standing next to the sofa

persos.nom: the mother in the kitchen doorway
persos.desc: mother in her 30s, indigo tie-dye dress, carrying a big pot of food
persos.pose: standing in the kitchen doorway with the pot

dialogue: Mon petit, ta maman cuisine bien, hein ?
Oui ! Quand y a visiteurs.
jeu: The guest asks kindly. The boy answers with total honesty.
chute: The mother freezes in the doorway with the pot. End on a close-up of the mother's mortified face looking into the camera.

lieu: street mechanic garage in Abobo, Abidjan, old rusty car with the hood open, tools on the ground, oil stains

persos.nom: the mechanic with the wrench
persos.desc: mechanic in his 40s, shaved head, oil-stained red overalls, big wrench in hand
persos.pose: listing problems on his fingers

persos.nom: the car owner with the briefcase
persos.desc: car owner in his 50s, purple-and-white checkered shirt, bow legs, briefcase
persos.pose: listening, horrified

dialogue: Vieux père, faut changer moteur, frein et pneus.
Donc tu laisses seulement klaxon ?
jeu: The mechanic lists the problems. The owner answers sadly.
chute: The owner sadly presses the horn and it makes a tiny squeak. End on a close-up of the owner's devastated face looking into the camera.

lieu: under a bedroom window at night in Abobo, Abidjan, moonlight, a young man with a guitar standing outside

persos.nom: the young man with the guitar
persos.desc: skinny young man in his 20s, orange Hawaiian flower shirt, old guitar with one string, rose in his teeth
persos.pose: singing romantically under the window

persos.nom: the girl at the window
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, hair in big curlers, leaning out of the window
persos.pose: leaning out, touched, hands on her cheeks

dialogue: Ma chérie, je t'ai écrit une chanson dêh !
Chante !
Ça s'appelle : prête-moi cinq mille.
jeu: The young man plays one note dramatically. The girl is touched, then her face falls when he announces the title.
chute: The girl slams the window shut. End on a close-up of the young man's face as the rose falls from his teeth, looking into the camera.

lieu: small neighborhood shop in Abobo, Abidjan, baguettes in a basket, shelves of sugar and canned tomato

persos.nom: the customer with the coin
persos.desc: customer in her 30s, peach wax dress, hair in bantu knots, holding a coin
persos.pose: holding up the coin, outraged

persos.nom: the shopkeeper with the baguette
persos.desc: shopkeeper in his 40s, white kufi cap, grey vest over a long tunic
persos.pose: patting a baguette tenderly

dialogue: Hier, pain-là était cent francs dêh !
Oui. Mais il a dormi ici. Il paie loyer.
jeu: The customer protests. The shopkeeper pats the bread tenderly and answers calmly.
chute: The shopkeeper tucks the baguette into a tiny blanket like a baby. End on a close-up of the customer's disbelieving face looking into the camera.

lieu: veranda of a family house in Anyama near Abidjan, wooden rocking chair, sunset, chickens in the yard

persos.nom: the grandson with the tablet
persos.desc: grandson around 12, gaming headset around his neck, holding a tablet
persos.pose: asking with curiosity

persos.nom: the peaceful grandfather
persos.desc: grandfather in his 80s, snow-white hair, rust-orange kaftan, eyes closed
persos.pose: rocking peacefully in the rocking chair

dialogue: Papi, dans ton temps-là, y avait pas téléphone ?
Non mon petit. Nous on appelait ça la paix dêh !
jeu: The grandson asks. The grandfather keeps rocking with his eyes closed and answers with a peaceful smile.
chute: The tablet suddenly rings very loudly; the grandfather opens one eye and drops it into a bucket of water. End on a close-up of the grandson's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Riviera, Abidjan, a pile of unpaid bills on the coffee table, a packed suitcase by the door

persos.nom: the angry wife with the suitcase
persos.desc: angry wife in her 30s, electric-blue jumpsuit, long braided ponytail, dragging a suitcase
persos.pose: pointing at her husband, ready to leave

persos.nom: the calm husband with the bills
persos.desc: calm husband in his 40s, burgundy velvet smoking jacket, holding a thick stack of unpaid bills
persos.pose: calmly holding out the stack of bills

dialogue: C'est fini dêh ! Je veux divorce !
Ya fohi. Mais on va partager dettes aussi.
Euh… Chéri, on peut encore causer, hein.
jeu: The wife announces the divorce. The husband calmly hands her half of the bills. She stops dead.
chute: The wife drops the suitcase and sits down sweetly next to him. End on a close-up of the husband's smug face looking into the camera.
